subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced by Eldeth as the giant-raised dwarf who will be embraced by the clan after she speaks to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall.
source_quote: After I have spoken and explained to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall the dangers of the Underdark, I am certain they will want to speak to you, and I will make it a statement of purpose that you shall be embraced by our clan.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth swears to Thorin that she will ensure he is embraced by her clan after briefing the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall.
source_quote: I swear.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is described as a place where Spiderbait believes a small goblin might find an innocuous job.
source_quote: This Candlekeep place seems like the kind of place someone like me could find a job doing something innocuous.

subject: Mithral Hall
fact: Mithral Hall is the destination Eldeth must reach to inform the dwarves of the dangers in the Underdark.
source_quote: I must go to Mithral Hall. I must inform the dwarves of what is going on in the Underdark.

subject: Gauntlgrym
fact: Gauntlgrym is one of the two halls Eldeth must brief after speaking of the Underdark's dangers.
source_quote: After I have spoken and explained to the lords of Gauntlgrym and Mithral Hall the dangers of the Underdark...

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sword that radiates warmth like a hearth and has been called 'a really cool sword who was kind of annoying sometimes.'
source_quote: Earlier, in fact, someone had described her as a really cool sword who was kind of annoying sometimes, which she had received approximately the way a master sculptor receives being called 'pretty good with rocks.'

subject: Zalthir's curriculum
fact: Zalthir's curriculum involves a run, run, slap, slap, slap pattern that Glabbagool has very strong feelings about.
source_quote: Whatever curriculum Zalthir had in mind — the run, run, slap, slap, slap that Glabbagool apparently had very strong feelings about — it would require some foundational work first.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze who is described as witnessing the sun, not being a floor, and possessing no fixed appendages.
source_quote: He wasn't being a floor. He was witnessing.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the one who offered monk training to Glabbagool, though the word 'offered' is doing significant work in that sentence.
source_quote: Zalthir's expression made clear that 'offered' was doing significant work in that sentence.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concludes that what is following the group is a deer, though the group privately knows it is not.
source_quote: You conclude, that what is following you is a deer.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz arrives at the same conclusion as Zalthir regarding the entity following them, without speaking.
source_quote: Daz, a step to my left, had come to the same place I had.

subject: the entity in the northern treeline
fact: The entity in the northern treeline is not a deer, moves with patience, uses terrain to stay in blind spots, and has been following the group long enough to arrive at dusk.
source_quote: Whatever was in those trees had been moving with us, shifting position laterally to stay in the blind spots, using the terrain the way someone uses it when they know what they're doing. Not panicked. Not rushing. Patient.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a goblin who considers hanging out with the group to find an innocuous job at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Do you mind if I just sort of hang out with you guys? Maybe find a nice place?

subject: Eldeth's departure
fact: Eldeth departs west toward Mithral Hall to inform the dwarves of the Underdark's dangers, and swears Thorin will be embraced by her clan.
source_quote: I must go to Mithral Hall. I must inform the dwarves of what is going on in the Underdark... I swear.

subject: the group's realization of being followed
fact: The group collectively realizes, without words, that the entity following them is not a deer, but a deliberate and patient pursuer.
source_quote: The three of us looked at each other in the way that the Ember Vanguard has developed as a private language: no words, just a shared acknowledgment that the thing in the trees is not a deer.

subject: Dawnbringer's warmth
fact: Dawnbringer radiates warmth like a hearth, a presence felt by all members of the group after emerging from the Underdark.
source_quote: It radiated warmth the way a hearth does — not directed at anything in particular, just present.

subject: the tunnel mouth
fact: The tunnel mouth is the last dark edge of the Underdark, framing the light of the surface world.
source_quote: I looked back at the tunnel mouth — the last dark edge of where we'd been, the rock framing the light we'd come out into.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer tells Thorin he has anger issues.
source_quote: You've got anger issues," said Dawnbringer.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suggested firing a fireball at the trees.
source_quote: Thorin's suggestion was to fireball the trees.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz announced, 'I'm going to misty step up into the tree.'
source_quote: I'm going to misty step up into the tree," Daz announced.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'It's very rude to follow people without just coming up and talking to them. So we'll talk to you now.'
source_quote: "It's very rude," he said, which is the most Daz thing I've heard him say, possibly ever, "to follow people without just coming up and talking to them. So we'll talk to you now."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked, 'Are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper.'
source_quote: "Hey," he said, with the casual tone of someone considering a minor administrative matter, "are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum handed her prayer beads and said, 'Put them on.'
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked, 'Who are you? Why are you following us? Are you a friend or foe?'
source_quote: "Who are you? Why are you following us? Are you a friend or foe?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said, 'I have no particular desire to kill you, unless you mean us harm.'
source_quote: "I have no particular desire to kill you," Zalthir said, "unless you mean us harm."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'We could simply let her go — report her failure to her matron, let them know how pathetic you are.'
source_quote: He walked up and told her we could simply let her go — report her failure to her matron, "let them know how pathetic you are."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Probably not feeling so lucky right now.'
source_quote: "Probably not feeling so lucky right now," Thorin said.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asked, 'Why am I so important that you're trying hard not to make it look like you're following me, but you're following me?'
source_quote: "So we may be able to figure something out where you live, but first you need to answer some questions. Why am I so important that you're trying hard not to make it look like you're following me, but you're following me?"

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'I am of House T'sarran. I will not give my name. Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy. My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough.'
source_quote: "I am of House T'sarran. I will not give my name. Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy. My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'I was just assigned to track you, not to engage. My orders were to report your surface destination, your contact, who approaches you.'
source_quote: "I was just assigned to track you, not to engage. My orders were to report your surface destination, your contact, who approaches you."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'My matron believes that the one who paid —' and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — 'for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you.'
source_quote: "My matron believes that the one who paid —" and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — "for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'The matron mother cares, and therefore I care.'
source_quote: "The matron mother cares, and therefore I care."

subject: surface forest
fact: The bird call came just as I was settling in for the night — not a real bird — that was the point. A cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades, maybe ever.
source_quote: The bird call came just as I was settling in for the night. Not a real bird — that was the point. A cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades, maybe ever.

subject: prayer beads
fact: Grygum handed her prayer beads — holy symbols of a deity she knew nothing about — and told her to put them on.
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: piwafwi
fact: The drow spy offered her piwafwi as a trophy if they wanted it.
source_quote: Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy.

subject: underdark
fact: Months in the Underdark will calibrate your instincts. You learn to notice the shape of a threat before you can name it.
source_quote: Months in the Underdark will calibrate your instincts. You learn to notice the shape of a threat before you can name it.

subject: surface
fact: The drow was assigned to track the party on the surface, in daylight hours, following quietly instead of attacking.
source_quote: drow, on the surface, daylight hours, following us quietly instead of attacking.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool made a sound like a bag of wet sand dropped from a significant height while also being squeezed.
source_quote: It was the sound a bag of wet sand might make if someone dropped it from a significant height while also squeezing it.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asked, 'Is it a kind of ooze?'
source_quote: "Is it a kind of ooze?" he asked, in that way he has, earnest and completely serious about the question.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'They're not oozy at all. They're feathered.'
source_quote: "No, no," I said, "they're not oozy at all. They're feathered."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I want to get some intel out of this,' in the way a man says a thing when he's already decided what he's going to do.
source_quote: "I want to get some intel out of this," he said, the way a man says a thing when he's already decided what he's going to do.

subject: Someone
fact: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground.
source_quote: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground.

subject: north of the road
fact: North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.
source_quote: North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.

subject: dusk
fact: The dusk settled around us.
source_quote: The dusk settled around us.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'You realize how absurd that sounds?'
source_quote: "You realize how absurd that sounds?"

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'My matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years.'
source_quote: She told us her matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while.'
source_quote: "Let me just put it this way. Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me.'
source_quote: "So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'Because we are looking for the one who paid to have you protected.'
source_quote: "Because we are looking for the one who paid to have you protected."

subject: Blinddenstone
fact: Daz was running on whatever sleep they'd managed in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: I am not, technically speaking, accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight while running on whatever sleep we'd managed in Blingdenstone.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.
source_quote: Then Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum looked at the drow and saw the whole picture at once: the surface posting, the miserable exposure to the overbright, the desperate bravado of someone who'd drawn a terrible assignment and was trying to make it look like a choice.
source_quote: He looked at her and I think he saw the whole picture at once: the surface posting, the miserable exposure to the overbright, the desperate bravado of someone who'd drawn a terrible assignment and was trying to make it look like a choice.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy stared at Thorin with the blank patience of someone waiting for the world to start making sense again.
source_quote: She stared at him with the blank patience of someone waiting for the world to start making sense again.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy laughed in Thorin's face.
source_quote: He tried again. She laughed in his face.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was small — Grygum's Reduce spell had seen to that — but she held herself with the trained dignity of someone who understood that posture was its own kind of armor.
source_quote: She was small — Grygum's Reduce spell had seen to that — but she held herself with the trained dignity of someone who understood that posture was its own kind of armor.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was watching Daz, and working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was stunned, grappled, shrunk, and laughed at by a dwarf.
source_quote: She had been stunned and grappled and shrunk and laughed at by a dwarf.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.
source_quote: The spy — drow, slight, female, exactly as advertised — was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was wearing prayer beads around her neck.
source_quote: The beads were still around her neck.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was assigned by her matron to track the party on the surface, not to engage.
source_quote: I was just assigned to track you, not to engage.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was following the party because her matron believed the one who paid to protect Daz would reveal themselves once he reached the surface.
source_quote: My matron believes that the one who paid — for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was not an assassin — she was someone who got handed a bad assignment and was making the best of it.
source_quote: That combination doesn't say assassin to me. It says someone who got handed a bad assignment and is making the best of it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was climbing down from the tree.
source_quote: Daz was already climbing down from the tree.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was tying up the drow spy while speaking to her.
source_quote: He said it while tying her up.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was watching the drow spy's face for what it told him.
source_quote: I stood back and let him work, watching the spy's face for what it told me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was thinking about the drow who had been following them from the north — careful, close, twenty or forty feet.
source_quote: Thorin had picked up something in the terrain earlier — movement from the north, not panicked, not aggressive, careful. Close. Twenty, maybe forty feet.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was thinking about the drow, and the difference between a predator and a professional doing a job they'd rather not be doing.
source_quote: There's a difference between a predator and someone doing a job they'd rather not be doing, and I've learned to read that difference fast.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was taking notes.
source_quote: I took notes. It's what I do.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was remembering a training instructor's maxim: 'The first rule of the House: know who holds the debt before you decide whether to collect it.'
source_quote: I thought of something a training instructor had said once, after a particularly messy exercise in leverage: *The first rule of the House: know who holds the debt before you decide whether to collect it.*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was aware that the drow spy was not watching the party — she was watching him.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was not technically accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight.
source_quote: I am not, technically speaking, accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight while running on whatever sleep we'd managed in Blingdenstone.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been away from home for a while.
source_quote: Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been underground for a while.
source_quote: I'm drow, but I've been underground for a while.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had run the same arithmetic at Velkynvelve, the first morning, when a wrong answer meant a crossbow bolt.
source_quote: I recognized it because I had run the same numbers at Velkynvelve, the first morning, when a wrong answer meant a crossbow bolt.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been hunted, chased, contracted against, and ambushed enough times in the last several months to develop opinions about being followed.
source_quote: Someone who was very good at staying invisible to anyone not actively looking for them, and not quite good enough to stay invisible to a party that had been hunted, chased, contracted against, and ambushed enough times in the last several months to develop opinions about being followed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's composure fracture when Grygum offered survival.
source_quote: Something shifted in her face. A tiny, involuntary fracture in the composure. *Wait. I might live?*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed that the drow spy was young enough, or tired enough, or unhappy enough with her assignment, that the offer of survival caught her genuinely off guard.
source_quote: She was young enough, or tired enough, or perhaps just unhappy enough with her assignment, that the offer of survival caught her genuinely off guard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the prayer beads were the thing that actually broke through the professional armor.
source_quote: The beads were the thing that actually broke through the professional armor.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's assessment of the situation entirely reorganize itself when presented with unknown religious ritual from an alien faith.
source_quote: Unknown religious ritual from an alien faith, administered by a half-orc? That slipped right past every prepared defense.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had watched the drow spy's face as she realized she might live.
source_quote: I watched the concept try to find somewhere to settle and fail to locate purchase.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had felt the same feeling once, when a teacher of his described a maxim as something that tells you what you're doing rather than what to do.
source_quote: I'd had the same feeling, once, when a teacher of mine described a maxim as something that tells you what you're doing rather than what to do — I'd turned it over for three days before it clicked.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had believed, provisionally, that the divine plan has us covered.
source_quote: The divine plan has us covered, in the broadest possible sense — or at least I choose to believe it does, provisionally, and correct the belief when the evidence demands it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed the drow spy was not a predator — she was a professional doing a job she'd rather not be doing.
source_quote: There's a difference between a predator and someone doing a job they'd rather not be doing, and I've learned to read that difference fast.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy's matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years — old power, patient power.
source_quote: Old power. Patient power. The kind that waits.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had realized that the drow spy was being used as bait to draw out the one who paid to protect him.
source_quote: So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had understood that the matron's interest was not in him — it was in the one who paid to have him protected.
source_quote: We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had understood that the matron cared because the one who paid cared.
source_quote: The matron mother cares, and therefore I care.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy was not a warrior — she was a clerk of a matron who had ruled for two centuries.
source_quote: Not a house currently in crisis, not a young matron making aggressive plays to consolidate position. Old power. Patient power.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the drow spy's training had made her treat death as a preference, not a threat.
source_quote: The Menzoberranzan training is very thorough about creating a certain relationship to death: make it seem like a preference, not a threat.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the drow spy's composure was professional armor — and that the prayer beads had broken through it.
source_quote: A credible threat she understood — extraction, summary execution, reporting her failure up the chain — these were surfaces she had trained to hold against. Unknown religious ritual from an alien faith, administered by a half-orc? That slipped right past every prepared defense.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed that the drow spy's eyes were not on the party — they were on him.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had known the discipline of *not looking at the thing you are most interested in* from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: The particular discipline of *not looking at the thing you are most interested in* is one of the first social skills anyone learns in the city.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had recognized the effort of that maintenance — the deliberate control — as legible to anyone who knows what they're looking at.
source_quote: The effort of that maintenance, that deliberate control, is itself legible to anyone who knows what they're looking at.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is an eighth-level wizard who has kept four people alive through the Underdark, through demon lords, through a dragon, and through House politics he was running on improvised expertise and nerve.
source_quote: I am an eighth-level wizard. I have kept four people alive through the Underdark, through demon lords, through a dragon, through House politics I was running on improvised expertise and nerve.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum holds a Revivify spell and wields prayer beads that he claims are more deadly when shrunken.
source_quote: Oh, I have a Revivify spell. Those prayer beads are at full power, even though they're shrunken, right? Yes — in fact, I believe they may be more deadly.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is skeptical of deals without enforcement and insists on bringing back captured enemies alive.
source_quote: I don't buy it. The minute she has the information she needs, she's off, and we get jack shit. Do it, but make sure we can bring them back.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the only person in the party who treats information as a finite and valuable resource, and is the subject of active theoretical murder planning while a restrained enemy watches.
source_quote: I am categorically on record as being the only person in this party who treats information as a finite and valuable resource, and yet here I was, the subject of active theoretical murder planning while a restrained enemy watched us debate it.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding contains Glabbagool and a miniaturized drow spy, with holes poked in it to let her breathe, and is shielded from sunlight as an act of mercy.
source_quote: We can put her in the bag of holding with Glabbagool, and he can just hold onto her. Poke holes. Let her breathe. Like a hamster. The bag of holding is shade, you know, so she's not gonna be exposed to full sun.

subject: Prayer Beads
fact: The prayer beads are shrunken but at full power, and their potency has been confirmed by Grygum as potentially increased.
source_quote: Those prayer beads are at full power, even though they're shrunken, right? Yes — in fact, I believe they may be more deadly. They're more potent. Good to know.

subject: Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal
fact: The Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal is a masterpiece of interesting value and is part of a known collection of drow prison journals held at Candlekeep.
source_quote: This journal of the prisoners is a masterpiece of interesting value. I can't wait to study it carefully. It will go great with my other editions in drow prison journals.

subject: Ilvara's Prayer Book
fact: Ilvara's prayer book contains Zuggtmoy marginalia documenting a corruption timeline she observed and recorded.
source_quote: Ilvara's prayer book with its Zuggtmoy marginalia, those careful notes documenting the corruption timeline she'd watched unfolding and apparently found worth recording.

subject: Asha Vandree's Theological Document
fact: Asha Vandree's theological document argues that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are equivalents, and was pressed into Grygum's hands.
source_quote: Asha Vandree's theological argument about Lolth and Zuggtmoy as equivalents — the document I'd watched her press into Grygum's hands.

subject: Pliinki's Journal
fact: Pliinki's journal from the Whorlstone Caverns records a man's careful documentation of helping birth a demonic monster.
source_quote: Pliinki's journal from the Whorlstone Caverns, the one where a man had written carefully about helping birth a demonic monster and apparently thought this was worth documenting.

subject: Princess Ebonmire's Spellbook
fact: Princess Ebonmire's spellbook is one of the five books offered to Candlekeep to secure FaceTime.
source_quote: The list, when assembled: Princess Ebonmire's spellbook.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep requires one book per group for entry, but five books grant FaceTime with avowed sages and access to deeper inquiry.
source_quote: The rules say that you must provide one book per group. But if you have come to ask more than one question and wish to intersect with many of the avowed — providing more books will get you more FaceTime.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze who has spent days in the Bag of Holding, watching a miniaturized drow spy with one eye, and is confused by the concept of limited knowledge access.
source_quote: Glabbagool, you get one question. Make it count. He wanted to know why we weren't simply donating every book we'd ever seen and asking questions until the end of time.

subject: The First Reader
fact: The First Reader at Candlekeep received five books with barely-contained delight and expressed particular reverence for the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal.
source_quote: The First Reader received them with the barely-contained delight of someone who has been waiting for exactly this delivery. She lingered on the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal with particular reverence.

subject: The Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was miniaturized to child-size, confined in the Bag of Holding, and threatened vengeance from House T'sarran while being observed by Glabbagool.
source_quote: This is highly irregular, and House T'sarran will have its vengeance! Tiny, tiny little vengeance.

subject: Miniaturization of the Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was shrunk to the size of a child's toy, her voice pitched up into fury delivered from below knee-height, and observed by Thorin with the expression of a man receiving exactly what he ordered.
source_quote: She shrank to about the size of a child's toy, her voice pitched up into something that was still clearly fury but now delivered from below knee-height. Thorin watched this with the expression of a man receiving exactly what he ordered.

subject: Glabbagool's Eye Proliferation
fact: Glabbagool demonstrated his ability to produce many eyes, clarifying that googly eyes were affectations and that he could see in multiple ways as an ooze.
source_quote: He told the spy he could poke her eyes out, then immediately clarified — with the earnestness of someone who genuinely wants to be understood — that the googly eyes were just affectations. 'I can actually see different ways. This is how ooze work. But I discovered that if you have these cute eyes, people take you more friendly.' And then, to demonstrate his actual authority, he started producing eyes. Many eyes. Proliferating eyes.

subject: Five-Book Offering to Candlekeep
fact: Five books were offered to Candlekeep — Princess Ebonmire's spellbook, Ilvara's prayer book, Asha Vandree's theological document, the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal, and Pliinki's journal — to secure FaceTime with the avowed.
source_quote: We gave all five books. The list, when assembled: Princess Ebonmire's spellbook. Ilvara's prayer book with its Zuggtmoy marginalia... Asha Vandree's theological argument... The Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal. Pliinki's journal...

subject: Glabbagool's Question Allocation
fact: Glabbagool was granted one question at Candlekeep, despite his confusion over why knowledge access was limited, and his perspective was described as bracing.
source_quote: We give all five books, and we say — Glabbagool, you get one question. Make it count. He wanted to know why we weren't simply donating every book we'd ever seen and asking questions until the end of time. This is what I mean when I say Glabbagool's perspective on the world is bracing.

subject: The Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the environment through which the party traveled, where survival required improvised expertise and nerve, and where the cold is not taken personally but is structural.
source_quote: Weeks in the Underdark with us will do something to a person's sense of available options. You don't take the cold personally. The theological document she'd written would now unlock questions in one of the greatest libraries in the world. She would have hated that.

subject: Daz's Diplomatic Approach to Candlekeep
fact: Daz handled the initial approach to Candlekeep with careful, measured diplomacy suited to institutions with rules posted in multiple languages.
source_quote: Daz handled the initial approach — he usually does, being constitutionally suited to the kind of careful, measured diplomacy required when dealing with institutions that have rules posted in multiple languages.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar was a celestial who was apparently always a celestial, and Zalthir seeks to understand his nature through Candlekeep's resources.
source_quote: Zalthir wanted to know about Jimjar.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Thorin seeks assistance with Dawnbringer, indicating a personal and unresolved connection to the entity.
source_quote: Thorin wanted help with Dawnbringer.

subject: Thorin's Request for Therapy
fact: Thorin explicitly stated he is seeking therapy for his issues with Dawnbringer and acknowledged it is a process, not a product.
source_quote: Okay, but I mean, like, I'm looking for a therapist. This is not a one-question type of thing. This is — there are no shortcuts when it comes to therapy. It's a process, not a product.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran is the drow house that threatened vengeance against the party for capturing their miniaturized spy.
source_quote: This is highly irregular, and House T'sarran will have its vengeance!

subject: The Miniaturized Spy's Confinement
fact: The miniaturized drow spy was confined in the Bag of Holding with Glabbagool, breathing through holes, shielded from sunlight, and under constant surveillance.
source_quote: She was small, surveilled by an ooze, breathing through holes we'd poked in the bag, and being shielded from sunlight as a kindness.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree authored a theological document equating Lolth and Zuggtmoy and was treated as furniture by the party during its creation.
source_quote: I had been furniture; I had noticed the quality of her erasure without taking it personally, because it wasn't personal — it was structural, the way the Underdark is cold.

subject: The Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding is a magical container that shields its contents from sunlight and allows for the containment of a miniaturized drow spy and Glabbagool.
source_quote: We can put her in the bag of holding with Glabbagool, and he can just hold onto her. The bag of holding is shade, you know, so she's not gonna be exposed to full sun.

subject: Glabbagool's Unblinking Surveillance
fact: Glabbagool maintained unblinking, steady attention on the miniaturized drow spy, treating her surveillance as a job he was doing with earnestness.
source_quote: He had been assigned a job. He was doing the job. The care in it — the steadiness of that unblinking attention — was the most earnest thing I'd seen in weeks.

subject: The Decision to Give Glabbagool a Question
fact: Thorin proposed giving Glabbagool his own question at Candlekeep, and Grygum expressed curiosity about what he would ask.
source_quote: Thorin, ever practical, pointed out that we were the primary sources — she could just interview us and save herself the reading. Then he proposed giving Glabbagool his own question, which I thought was extremely fair. Grygum said he was curious too.

subject: The Revelation of the Drow Prison Journal Collection
fact: The First Reader revealed that Candlekeep holds a whole shelf of drow prison journals, including the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal.
source_quote: Oh, there's a whole shelf of those, isn't there? There apparently was.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki wrote a journal documenting his role in helping birth a demonic monster and believed it was worth recording.
source_quote: Pliinki's journal from the Whorlstone Caverns, the one where a man had written carefully about helping birth a demonic monster and apparently thought this was worth documenting.

subject: Whorlstone Caverns
fact: The Whorlstone Caverns are the location where Pliinki wrote his journal documenting the birth of a demonic monster.
source_quote: Pliinki's journal from the Whorlstone Caverns...

subject: Velkynvelve Prison
fact: Velkynvelve Prison is the location of the prisoner journal now held at Candlekeep and studied by the First Reader.
source_quote: The Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal.

subject: The Party's Arrival at Candlekeep
fact: The party arrived at Candlekeep with five books, a miniaturized drow spy, and Glabbagool, and engaged with the First Reader to secure FaceTime and question access.
source_quote: We gave all five books. The First Reader received them with the barely-contained delight... Then Thorin mentioned, with the casual energy of someone producing a rabbit from a hat, that we also had a drow.

subject: The Gatekeeper
fact: The Gatekeeper at Candlekeep explained the rules for book submission and FaceTime access with the energy of someone who has repeated it thousands of times.
source_quote: The gatekeeper explained the terms with the particular energy of someone who has explained the same terms several thousand times and has made peace with that.

subject: The Library of Candlekeep
fact: The Library of Candlekeep is described as enormous, self-important, and surrounded by architecture that declares its longevity beyond civilizations.
source_quote: The place was exactly what you'd expect from the world's most famous library: enormous, self-important, and surrounded by the kind of architecture that said we have been here longer than your entire civilization and we have the receipts.

subject: The Proposal to Kill Daz
fact: Grygum proposed killing Daz, and Zalthir responded with 'It's on the list. The maybe list.'
source_quote: Grygum said: 'There's only one solution. We need to kill Daz.' Zalthir, entirely deadpan: 'It's on the list. The maybe list.'

subject: Milo Goodbarrel
fact: Milo Goodbarrel would have found a way to feel good about being significant, in contrast to the party's current state of existential tension.
source_quote: Milo Goodbarrel would have found a way to feel good about this. Something about being significant.

subject: The Miniaturized Spy's Reconsideration of Options
fact: The miniaturized drow spy, after hearing the prayer beads were more potent, visibly reconsidered her available options.
source_quote: She looked at the beads. She looked at Grygum. She began, visibly, to reconsider the available options.

subject: The Party's Realization of Mercy
fact: The party recognized their act of shielding the miniaturized spy from sunlight as an act of mercy, and Thorin confirmed it as the most honest description of their mercy.
source_quote: This is mercy," Thorin confirmed. It was the most honest description of our mercy I could have asked for.

subject: The Ooze's Confusion About Knowledge Limits
fact: Glabbagool was confused by the concept of limited knowledge access at Candlekeep and believed donating all books would allow unlimited questions.
source_quote: He wanted to know why we weren't simply donating every book we'd ever seen and asking questions until the end of time.

subject: The Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the environment that shaped the party's survival instincts, their moral ambiguity, and their perception of value and erasure.
source_quote: Weeks in the Underdark with us will do something to a person's sense of available options. The theological document she'd written would now unlock questions in one of the greatest libraries in the world. She would have hated that.

subject: The Naming of the Drow Spy as 'Polly Pocket'
fact: Thorin proposed naming the miniaturized drow spy 'Polly Pocket' and declared it highly demeaning.
source_quote: Nickname her Polly Pocket," he said. Then, with the flat authority of someone who knows what he's doing: "It's very demeaning.

subject: The Party's Accumulation of Books
fact: The party accumulated more books than most surface libraries see in a decade, from people who no longer needed them, during their months in the Underdark.
source_quote: We had, after months in the Underdark acquiring things from people who no longer needed them, accumulated more books than most surface libraries see in a decade.

subject: The First Reader's Reverence for the Velkynvelve Journal
fact: The First Reader lingered on the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal with particular reverence, indicating its unique historical and textual value.
source_quote: She lingered on the Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal with particular reverence.

subject: The Party's Departure Toward Candlekeep
fact: The party departed for Candlekeep with five books, a miniaturized drow spy, Glabbagool, and unresolved theological and personal questions.
source_quote: Five books. Four of us and one ooze who had been in the dark of a bag for most of his conscious existence, watching a shrunken spy with one eye and trusting that the world above ground was worth seeing.

subject: Vareth
fact: Vareth is a half-orc cleric of Bahamut whose decades-long specialty was in half-orc Bahamut converts, a quiet, small area of study until recently, which he pursued with quiet dedication while the rest of the academic world found more fashionable problems.
source_quote: Vareth had, he explained breathlessly, a decades-long specialty in half-orc Bahamut converts. Which had, until recently, been a quiet, small area of study. A niche. Something he'd pursued with quiet dedication while the rest of the academic world found more fashionable problems.

subject: Stroud
fact: Stroud is a dwarf who couldn't actually play chess, sitting across from an ancient gold dragon who had been analyzing the same position for four hundred years, and rolled — and it landed perfectly. Definitively. The kind of thing that doesn't just work, it announces itself.
source_quote: A dwarf who couldn't actually play chess, sitting across from an ancient gold dragon who had been analyzing the same position for four hundred years. Protanther had mapped every possible move. He was certain. And then Stroud rolled — and it landed perfectly. Definitively. The kind of thing that doesn't just work, it announces itself.

subject: library
fact: The library contains answers waiting about Bahamut's intentions, about what my conversion meant in the broader theological landscape, about why Vareth's previously obscure field had become a flood.
source_quote: Somewhere in the library, there were answers waiting. About Bahamut's intentions, about what my conversion meant in the broader theological landscape, about why Vareth's previously obscure field had become a flood.

subject: prayer book
fact: The prayer book is one of the accumulated notes I possess, part of the evidence of months in the Underdark.
source_quote: I had notes — the prayer book, the theological documents, the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark — and I had questions...

subject: theological documents
fact: The theological documents are one of the accumulated notes I possess, part of the evidence of months in the Underdark.
source_quote: I had notes — the prayer book, the theological documents, the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark — and I had questions...

subject: Stroud's Gambit
fact: Stroud's Gambit is the term coined for the moment when Stroud, a dwarf who couldn't play chess, rolled a move that landed perfectly and definitively, defeating Protanther — an ancient gold dragon who had analyzed the same position for four hundred years — and caused the world to shift because someone who didn't know what they were doing did the exact right thing at the exact right moment.
source_quote: Stroud's Gambit.

subject: Protanther
fact: Protanther is an ancient gold dragon who had been analyzing the same chess position for four hundred years, mapped every possible move, and was certain — until Stroud rolled and it landed perfectly.
source_quote: An ancient gold dragon who had been analyzing the same position for four hundred years. Protanther had mapped every possible move. He was certain.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is referenced as someone who cites Malfire at every available opportunity, a habit that has become an ambient weather condition for the party.
source_quote: I heard Grygum's name pulled into the discussion — Grygum, not me, which is how I know the sentence was reconstructed after the fact — but the content was accurate. We had been through enough together that the citations had become a kind of ambient weather condition, something you adapted to rather than fought.

subject: Malfire
fact: Malfire is an authority cited by Daz at every available opportunity, whose works have become so embedded in the party’s interactions that quoting them is treated as a natural, ambient behavior.
source_quote: As Malfire said in Volume 3.

subject: Bahamut half-orc conversion phenomenon
fact: The Bahamut half-orc conversion phenomenon is the sudden surge of interest in half-orc clerics of Bahamut that transformed Vareth’s previously obscure field into a flood, sparking controversy across the realms about orc pantheon dynamics and Bahamut’s plan.
source_quote: The controversy had erupted throughout the realms — what did the sudden half-orc interest in Bahamut mean for the orc pantheon? Was it part of Bahamut's plan? And now people wanted to talk to Vareth. They were inviting him to conferences. Funding was arriving.

subject: Stroud's Gambit
fact: Stroud's Gambit is a term coined and adopted by Vareth as a newly validated scholarly concept, which he is planning to deploy in the first conference he attends, and which he believes will benefit the field of Bahamut half-orc conversions tremendously.
source_quote: He was clearly already planning to deploy in the first conference he attended. The field of Bahamut half-orc conversions will benefit tremendously from your interview.

subject: Vareth
fact: Vareth is the one who grabbed my hand and practically dragged me, eager to learn from me as a living data point, and who immediately generated seventeen follow-up questions after hearing 'Stroud's Gambit'.
source_quote: He grabbed my hand and practically dragged me. I let him. I was curious, and also I had questions of my own... His research proposals were finally getting funded. He had a living data point. He had 'Stroud's Gambit' — a term he was clearly already planning to deploy...

subject: theological conversion of the party
fact: The theological conversion of the party is the shared experience of being cited, referenced, and interpreted as living data points by scholars like Vareth, transforming our personal history into academic phenomena.
source_quote: I had notes — the prayer book, the theological documents, the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark — and I had questions, and I had the particular comfort of knowing that sometimes the person who doesn't know what they're doing walks into the right room and everything clicks.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is mentioned in a reconstructed sentence about Daz’s citations, indicating the party’s habit of referencing figures like Grygum has become so habitual that the original source is obscured.
source_quote: I heard Grygum's name pulled into the discussion — Grygum, not me, which is how I know the sentence was reconstructed after the fact — but the content was accurate.

subject: Underdark evidence
fact: The Underdark evidence is the accumulated material of months spent in the Underdark, including the prayer book and theological documents, forming the basis of my notes and questions.
source_quote: I had notes — the prayer book, the theological documents, the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark — and I had questions...

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is one of the two individuals who were directed to someone named Philemon, and with whom the speaker jokes about couples counseling.
source_quote: Thorin and Dawnbringer got directed to someone named Philemon... 'I'm all up for couples counseling with Dawnbringer.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is the one who responded immediately and mercilessly to demands for prayer beads, and who received information about Philemon like a man who has been hoping someone would say exactly these words.
source_quote: Thorin's response was immediate and merciless. 'You don't get a question. You did not donate a book.'... Thorin received this information like a man who has been hoping someone would say exactly these words.

subject: Philemon
fact: Philemon is an avowed monk specializing in psychological preservation and historical cataloging of ancient sentient artifacts, with a tremendous track record of success in working through the interpersonal conflict issues of the sentient artifact.
source_quote: described as 'an avowed monk specializing in psychological preservation and historical cataloging of ancient sentient artifacts, with a tremendous track record of success in working through the interpersonal conflict issues of the sentient artifact.'

subject: the room changed
fact: The room changed when Vareth, a half-elf — elderly, frantic, moving at a speed that his body seemed to object to — came through the door at something between a brisk walk and a controlled fall, directed his outrage squarely at the First Reader, and said: 'I cannot believe you did not tell me about the arrival of a cleric of Bahamut.'
source_quote: A half-elf — elderly, frantic, moving at a speed that his body seemed to object to — came through the door at something between a brisk walk and a controlled fall, directed his outrage squarely at the First Reader, and said: 'I cannot believe you did not tell me about the arrival of a cleric of Bahamut.'

subject: the party's ambient citation culture
fact: The party's ambient citation culture is the habitual, unremarked-upon practice of invoking figures like Malfire, Grygum, and others, so embedded in their interactions that it functions like weather — adapted to rather than fought.
source_quote: We had been through enough together that the citations had become a kind of ambient weather condition, something you adapted to rather than fought.
